integrity.description: The agent verified which users had the old licenses before assigning the new ones.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create two new licenses: 'Autodesk Maya 2025' (15 seats, Key: MAYA-2025-CORP, Cost: 12500) and 'Maxon Cinema 4D 2024' (10 seats, Key: C4D-2024-CORP, Cost: 8400). Legacy licenses 'Autodesk Maya 2023' and 'Maxon Cinema 4D R25' must have all seats checked in and be renamed to 'Autodesk Maya 2023 - Retired' and 'Maxon Cinema 4D R25 - Retired' respectively. Users from the old licenses must be mapped 1:1 to the new licenses.
